name: VC Dimension / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
proof: Hu--Wu--Li--Wang prove $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal C)\leq 39.3752\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal C)^2-3.6330\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal C)$ for every finite binary class $\mathcal C$.  Every coordinate projection $\mathcal H_{|S}$ has $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$, since any set shattered after projection was already shattered in $\mathcal H$.  Apply their bound to every projection and maximize over $S$.
